title: Flat, the skyline, the folder tower, the city and the street
description: Which of its ways in the page shows, and how the reader moves between them: Flat, Cyberspace's folder tower, its city and the city's street, and the flat view a ~space address gets where Cyberspace can't run. The address decides it: route() reads its last segment, and every move here either changes the address (a new history entry, so Back and Forward retrace it) or replaces the entry (a selection, a floor slid back, walking). A repository with several folders has a skyline above the folder towers. The views a city stands beside the one in the address (its layers) are not in the address: they last while the reader stays in that folder's city and its street.

states.description: The flat page: the folder column, and the folder's drawings, cards and tables. The address has no ~space segment.

Cyberspace's skyline (#<folder>|~space:skyline), above the folder towers of a repository with several folders: every folder a building on a radial tree round the root, a floor plate per view in its kind's colour, dashed lines to the folder it is in. The address folder's building is lit and ringed and the camera is aimed at it; the folder card on the right is its tower's, with what the repository holds and Enter <its title>. A building under the pointer, or focused with Tab, lights and shows the hover card. Walk is off, and Esc does nothing: the skyline is the top. The status line says how many folders have views; its hint, Drag to orbit · click a building to enter it.

Cyberspace's folder tower: the address folder as a stack of glass floors, one per .dev file, drawn at the bottom, then written, then knowledge, with labels and group brackets on the left, the folder's card and the pulled-out floor's card on the right. One drawn floor at a time is pulled out to the right with its city standing on it, small; the address names it (#<folder>|view:<file>|~space), or names none (#<folder>|~space, the first drawn view). A written or knowledge floor's inspector can be open in place of the cards. The status line says how many floors the tower has; its hint, Scroll to climb · click a floor to pull it out.

Cyberspace's city: one drawn view (#<folder>|view:<file>|~space:city, or a part's focus with it selected) standing full size on the ground, with its labels, legend and camera controls; a selected part lights its traces on the floor, raises them as beams and opens the inspector. The status line's hint is Esc goes up a level. The Layers panel on the left lists the folder's views: ticking a drawn view stands its city 12 units right of the last, unticking fades it out, and a file's use cases or journeys are radio buttons that change the address; written and knowledge views are listed, disabled.

Cyberspace's street: the city's own meshes seen from eye height (#<folder>|<kind>:<part>|~space:street, walked to that part, or #<folder>|view:<file>|~space:street, to the middle of the city), 61.2° of view with its centre low, a vignette and a crosshair. The reader walks with W A S D or the arrows, looks by dragging, rises and sinks with Space and Z; towers are solid and plates are steps. The breadcrumb, the key hints, the map and, over a part under the pointer, the hover card take the place of the city's legend and camera controls. The status line says where the eye walks; its hint, Esc rises back to orbit.

A ~space address where Cyberspace can't run: the flat view of the place before the marker, with the status line saying Cyberspace needs WebGL, which this browser has turned off. Showing the flat view. The Flat / Cyberspace switch is hidden.

transitions.trigger: Cyberspace in the bar's switch with no part selected in Flat, or an address gaining ~space or ~space:tower (a link)
transitions.guard: the browser has WebGL 2 and three.js loads
transitions.action: three.js is imported on the first entry; the tower stands at once, the view the address names (or the folder's first drawn view) pulled out, the camera in its opening pose; from the switch, the address is #<folder>|view:<first file of the open tab>|~space when the tab is drawn, #<folder>|~space otherwise, and #|~space from Waiting; the switch's Cyberspace is pressed

transitions.trigger: Cyberspace in the bar's switch with a part selected in Flat, or an address gaining ~space:city
transitions.guard: the browser has WebGL 2 and three.js loads
transitions.action: the city of the view or part it names stands, fitted to the room the panels leave; from the switch, the address is #<folder>|<kind>:<part>|~space:city, the part selected

transitions.trigger: the address gains ~space
transitions.guard: no WebGL 2 context can be had, or a WebGLRenderer can't be made

transitions.trigger: Cyberspace in the bar's switch, or an address gaining ~space
transitions.action: the status line says Cyberspace couldn't load its 3D library. Showing the flat view; the next entry tries again; the switch stays, so a later press can work

transitions.trigger: the address gains ~space:skyline
transitions.guard: the repository has several folders, the browser has WebGL 2 and three.js loads
transitions.action: the skyline stands at once, the camera on the address folder's building

transitions.trigger: the address gains ~space:skyline
transitions.action: that folder's tower stands, as for ~space: a repository with one folder has no skyline, and the folder card has no See the skyline

transitions.trigger: a click on a drawn floor that is not out
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|view:<file>|~space; the floor out slides back as this one slides out with its city, 450 ms eased out, at once with reduced motion; where it stands outside the room, the camera climbs to it

transitions.trigger: Slide back, or Esc with no inspector open
transitions.action: the floor slides back and the entry is replaced with #<folder>|~space; until the reader goes elsewhere every floor stays in. With none out Esc rises to the skyline

transitions.trigger: a click on a written or knowledge floor, or an address naming one (view:<file>, entity:<file>[#<record id>])
transitions.action: the inspector opens on that floor (title, kind, description, the record named, Read it in Flat) in place of the cards, its edges in --hot, the camera climbing to it where it stands outside the room, and the entry is replaced with its address; Esc or a click on empty ground closes it and the entry is the tower's again

transitions.trigger: Enter the city, a double-click on the pulled-out floor, or Enter
transitions.guard: the models can't build the view on it
transitions.action: the inspector opens on that floor with why, and Read it in Flat

transitions.trigger: a folder's chip under Inside on the folder card
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|~space; that folder's tower stands at once

transitions.trigger: Enter the city, a double-click on the pulled-out floor, or Enter
transitions.guard: the view on it was built
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|view:<file>|~space:city; the camera flies to the floor until its city fills the room the city's panels leave (600 ms), then in one frame the full-size city takes the small one's place, seen as it was, and the tower fades out behind it (200 ms). At once with reduced motion; input on the way lands it where the eye is

transitions.trigger: Esc with nothing selected
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|view:<file>|~space; in one frame the tower stands with this city pulled out on its floor, seen as the city was, fading in over 200 ms, and the camera flies to the tower's opening pose (600 ms). At once with reduced motion

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to the tower address of the city's own view
transitions.action: as Esc does; to a tower address with another view out, the tower stands at once

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a city address of the tower's folder
transitions.action: as Enter the city does, the view it names pulled out first if it isn't

transitions.trigger: Enter its folder on a selected part that has views of its own, or a link in the inspector to a view or record
transitions.action: a new history entry; that folder's tower stands at once, with the view pulled out or the floor's inspector open

transitions.trigger: a click on a tower, plate or beacon, Enter on its button in the list Tab walks, a link in the inspector to another part, or Back or Forward to a part's address; Esc or a click on empty ground with one selected
transitions.action: the part is selected or cleared, and the entry is replaced with its address or the view's own. Selected, the point the camera turns about glides to the part's middle, which comes to the centre of the room the inspector leaves, distance and angles kept (at once with reduced motion, stopped by input); cleared, nothing moves

transitions.trigger: Walk to <name> in the inspector, or Walk in the camera controls
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|<kind>:<part>|~space:street (#<folder>|view:<file>|~space:street with nothing selected); the camera flies from the orbit pose to the street's, 12 units from the part across the layout's flow, eased on an arc for 400 ms and 12 more a unit travelled (500 to 1200), and the HUD changes when it lands. At once with reduced motion; input on the way lands it where the eye is

transitions.trigger: the address gains ~space:street
transitions.guard: the browser has WebGL 2 and three.js loads
transitions.action: the city of the view or part it names stands, and the eye is put in the street at once

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a street address
transitions.action: the city stands at once, and the eye is put in the street, where the reader walked in that entry if they did

transitions.trigger: W A S D or the arrows, Alt with ← →, a drag, Space or Z
transitions.action: the eye walks at 6 units a second (14 with Shift), turns, looks (pitch within ±60°), rises or sinks (1.7 to 30 above the ground), sliding along towers and stepping onto plates over 150 ms; the history entry is replaced, its state holding where the eye is, at most four times a second

transitions.trigger: a click on a part, Enter on its button in the list Tab walks, Enter on the part under the crosshair, or Esc with one selected
transitions.action: the part is selected or cleared and the entry replaced, as in the city. The eye stays where it stands and turns to face the part, for 250 ms and 3 more a degree, at most 700 (at once with reduced motion, stopped by walking or a drag); at the crosshair the part is ahead already and nothing turns

transitions.trigger: a click on the map, or Walk to <name> in the inspector
transitions.action: the eye flies there, as high above the ground as it walks, out of any tower; at once with reduced motion

transitions.trigger: Esc with nothing selected, or the breadcrumb's view
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|view:<file>|~space:city; the camera flies back to the orbit pose the reader left, or to the fit where they hadn't moved it or came in by the street, and the city's HUD returns at once. At once with reduced motion

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a city address of the street's view
transitions.action: as Esc does

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a street address of the city's view
transitions.action: as Walk to does, to where the reader walked in that entry if they did

transitions.trigger: the breadcrumb's folder, or Back or Forward to a tower address of its folder
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|~space for the breadcrumb; the tower stands with this city pulled out, as it does from the city

transitions.trigger: an address without ~space: Open flat, Flat in the bar's switch, Back
transitions.action: from the switch, the address is #<folder>|<kind>:<part> with a part selected, #<folder>|view:<file> with none, and Flat shows that tab with the part selected; the switch's Flat is pressed

transitions.trigger: an address without ~space: Read it in Flat, Flat in the bar's switch, Back
transitions.action: from the switch, the address is #<folder>|<kind>:<part> with a part selected, #<folder>|view:<file> with none, and Flat shows that tab with the part selected; the switch's Flat is pressed

transitions.trigger: an address without ~space: Open flat, Flat in the bar's switch, Back
transitions.action: from the switch, the address is #<folder>|<kind>:<part> with a part selected, #<folder>|view:<file> with none, and Flat shows that tab with the part selected; the switch's Flat is pressed

transitions.trigger: an address without ~space
transitions.action: the status line's message goes

transitions.trigger: See the skyline on the folder card, its `and N more` chip, or Esc with no floor out and no inspector open
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|~space:skyline; in one frame the tower stands in its building, as wide as it, seen as it was, and the camera flies up and back to the skyline's pose (600 ms) as the tower fades out and the skyline in. At once with reduced motion

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a skyline address
transitions.action: as See the skyline does, landing on the building of the folder that address names

transitions.trigger: a click on a building, Enter on its button in the list Tab walks, Enter on the canvas (the building under the pointer or focused, else the address folder's), Enter <title> on the folder card, or a folder's chip
transitions.action: a new history entry #<folder>|~space; the camera flies down to the tower standing small in its building (600 ms) as the skyline fades out and the tower in, then in one frame the tower takes its own size, seen as its opening pose sees it. At once with reduced motion; input on the way lands it where the eye is

transitions.trigger: Back or Forward to a tower address
transitions.action: as entering a building does

transitions.trigger: a building under the pointer, Tab or Shift+Tab to its button in the list after the canvas, Esc, or another skyline address
transitions.action: the building lights and the hover card opens by it (Tab goes from building to building in folder order through the list, then on to the panels; a building focused out of view or under the folder card is brought just inside the room, and the pointer never moves the camera); Esc does nothing; another folder's skyline address flies the camera to its building

transitions.trigger: an address of the skyline (a link, or Back or Forward past the tower)
transitions.action: the skyline stands at once, and the city and its layers go

transitions.trigger: an address without ~space: Flat in the bar's switch (#<folder>), Back
transitions.action: the switch's Flat is pressed

transitions.trigger: a tick box in the Layers panel
transitions.action: ticked, the view's city stands 12 units right of the last, in its own kind's colour; unticked, it fades to the dim state over 200 ms and goes, and the cities right of it close up. A camera the reader hasn't moved fits again to everything standing over 300 ms. At once with reduced motion. The address and the history are left alone

transitions.trigger: a radio button in the Layers panel (one of a file's use cases or journeys), or Back or Forward to another view's city of the folder
transitions.action: a new history entry for that view; its city takes the place of the one in the address, and the layers stay standing beside it; one already standing as a layer becomes the address's where it stands

transitions.trigger: a click on a part of a city standing as a layer
transitions.action: that layer's view becomes the address's where it stands (the entry is replaced with #<folder>|<kind>:<part>|~space:city), the view that was there stays standing as a layer, and the part is selected in its own city; the camera turns toward it, as for any selection
